Class SimulationMetricsAggregator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.SimulationMetricsAggregator
public class SimulationMetricsAggregator extends Object

SimulationMetricsAggregator

Aggregates and calculates macroscopic, cliodynamic, thermodynamic, and demographic metrics for the planetary simulation engine.
Implements analytical formulas for energy capture (Leslie White's Law), resource depletion, systemic entropy (Boltzmann-Shannon), carrying capacity, institutional maturity, and Turchin's Structural-Demographic Theory (SDT) vulnerability indicators.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
